subject: Can stat_bin2d show boundaries or borders between bins?

messages.author: 92a46c9449c605e2
messages.subject: Can stat_bin2d show boundaries or borders between bins?
parts:
When adjacent bins are the same color, one cannot see where one ends and the next one begins.  Is it possible for stat_bin2d to show the boundaries of each bin (cell)?

I noticed that the user manual page for the similar stat_binhex at http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_hex.html shows output with cell boundaries.  That would be helpful in stat_bin2d.  Interestingly, when I run stat_binhex (ggplot2 2.0.0) I don't see any boundaries in the plots window of RStudio (v0.99.467)

Any tips?  Thanks

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Can stat_bin2d show boundaries or borders between bins?
parts:
On Mon, Feb 15, 2016 at 9:01 AM, 'Mauricio' via ggplot2 <ggp...@googlegroups.com> wrote:
stat_bin2d

Using the example from the docs, just add colour outside of the aes(). 

ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, depth, z = price)) + stat_summary_2d(colour="white")
